description: Retrospective application for the change of use from shop (A1) to martial arts school (D1) and erection of a single storey rear extension to an existing class room.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1539-01 Rev A; 1539-02 Rev A; 1539-12 Rev A; 1539-13; 1539-14. Received 07/02/2019
1539-03 Rev B; 1539-11 Rev B. Received 14/03/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for D1 (School/Training Centre) purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times: 11:00 to 21:00 Monday to Sunday and on Bank Holidays.
Condition : 4 - No refuse or other materials associated with the use shall be stored other than within the building on site

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Use Classes Order 1986 and the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 or any successor to both pieces of legislation, the premises shall not be used other than as a Martial Arts school without the prior agreement of the local planning authority, obtained through the submission and determination of an application for planning permission.
